label: First Way necessary first root witnesses the stage-one NECESSARY_2 CONCRETE_6 node (inference)
rule: Existential projection: keep concreteness, existence at w and necessity
meaning: The First Way's first mover that is a necessary actual first pure-act root is in particular a concrete individual existing at w and at every world accessible from w, on the same profile: the stage-one node of the modal spine. This gives that root-route node a support option through the First Way's own witness and the existing grounding closure, with no well-foundedness, inhabitedness or whole-roster premise.
